results.title: Bashar Mohammed hails Bechem United’s tactical discipline after victory over Aduana FC
results.description: Bechem United head coach Bashar Mohammed has praised his players for their tactical discipline following their 1-0 victory over Aduana FC in the Ghana Premier League. The Hunters secured all three points in their Matchweek 11 encounter at the Nana Agyemang Badu I Park in Dormaa Ahenkro, recording an important away victory. Mohammed was delighted with his team's performance, revealing that his players executed the game plan effectively to secure the maximum points."The atmosphere was very great for us because we really came with a very good game plan maybe at least to secure a point or get the maximum three points. Then our tactics really work well for us to get the maximum three points. So I congratulated my boys for the tactic discipline that we were having on the pitch," he said. The victory lifts Bechem United to fifth position on the league table with 19 points after 11 matches. The Hunters will now turn their attention to their next league assignment, where they will host Asante Kotoko on November 22 as they look to build on their impressive away result.
